n_words.definition: Count of alphabetic spaCy tokens (lexical words).

n_characters.definition: Original text length in Unicode code points.

n_sentences.definition: Count of spaCy sentences containing at least one lexical word.

sentence_length_mean.definition: Mean lexical words per nonempty spaCy sentence.

sentence_length_std.definition: Population SD of lexical words per sentence (ddof=0).

sentence_length_cv.definition: Sentence-length population SD divided by its mean.

mattr_50.definition: Mean TTR over all width-50 lexical-word windows; NaN below 50 words.

ttr.definition: Unique casefolded lexical words / lexical words; length-sensitive diagnostic.

hapax_ratio.definition: Types occurring exactly once / lexical words; length-sensitive.

word_length_mean.definition: Mean number of Unicode characters per lexical word.
